en: A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with four photographs. The upper left shows a large medieval hilltop castle with multiple towers and a forested backdrop. The upper right depicts a lakeside or riverside resort with boats, piers, and many people seated under umbrellas at an outdoor café. The lower left shows a dam or lakeside promenade crowded with visitors, with timber buildings nearby and dense forest in the background. The lower right displays a winding river or reservoir running through a wooded valley with a small boat on the water. In the center, elegant script text reads "Zschopau-Talsperre Kriebstein."
